unit_policy.scale_basis: MSFT states its amounts in units; the capture holds them unchanged and no scaling is applied.

data_limitations: the unit and currency policy: The depreciation role declares us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization, which the capture does not hold, so the lane cannot read the element the role names. The lane refuses rather than compute from the elements the capture happens to carry.

formula.denominator: the trailing twelve months of MSFT's reported operating income plus reported depreciation and amortization, each a discrete fiscal quarter, summed over four consecutive quarters
formula.expression: (as-traded close x cover-page shares outstanding) / TTM of (us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss + us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization)
formula.numerator: as-traded close on the evaluation date times the latest knowable cover-page shares outstanding

distribution.metric_label: MSFT reported operating profit plus reported depreciation and amortization multiple (research): market capitalization over the trailing twelve months of MSFT's reported operating income plus reported depreciation and amortization

production_refusal.statement: No production reference is created from this result, and none may be created from it.

distribution.reason_detail: The depreciation role declares us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization, which the capture does not hold, so the lane cannot read the element the role names. The lane refuses rather than compute from the elements the capture happens to carry.
distribution.research_use_label: RESEARCH USE ONLY. This distribution is computed from filed evidence that the production qualification regime does not admit. It is not a valuation reference, it is not a production reference chain input, and it must not be presented as one.

observation_lineage: The committed summary carries one line per evaluation date. The full lineage -- every operand, accession, element, period, unit and usable date -- is regenerated exactly by the lane from the capture, whose files are hashed in the capture manifest.
